stats.note: Torah #166 has zero cause/effect (eitza or cause-type) edges in torahData.js for reference 166. The teaching is a two-sentence aphorism with minimal causal structure. The packages file (torah_166_packages.json) contains 5 nodes across 2 packages, all derived from gap analysis of the source text. The additions file (torah_166_additions.json) lists the same 5 nodes. Since there are no cause/effect edges in the dataset, there are no nodes to assign. The single causal move in the teaching (world-gathered-at-tzaddik -> memshala) was noted in the packages file's eitza_summary but does not appear as an edge in torahData.js.
